# Marketing and Chat bot correction register · 3 Nov 2026

Branch: `codex/crm-marketing-chat-design`. Status: **Changed after approval, awaiting founder**.

Implements the 15-point founder brief and the 11:37 PT ruling: white/light CRM surfaces across Marketing and Chat bot; navy text and positive actions. No dark sidebar, panel, band or theme remains in these screen roots. Navy button fills and the existing four On/Off toggle tracks are controls, not background panels. Client widget accent/ink variables remain client-owned.

## Evidence and practical limits

- Action Primary `266:3032` binds navy `VariableID:42:14`; positive action instances have matching navy fallback paint. The red Trigger wordmarks are navy.
- All 40 confirm screens keep their root IDs; fields are in the scroll area, then Cancel and Confirm are pinned in an 80px footer. Screenshots verify both buttons remain visible at 1440 and 375.
- The shared white CRM menu uses `180:8387` / `180:8467`, the same source as reference `182:9119`; Google posts is added and Post detail is absent. Every menu row is at least 44px, with 8px padding. Active entries use a light tint and navy text. Navigation scrolls above the pinned account block. Mobile parent-area drawers are listed below.
- Existing screen, navigation instance and field root IDs are preserved. Swapping a menu to the canonical component changes its inherited descendant IDs; `changes.json` records the from/to source IDs. Existing compact cards `149:10806` / `149:14873` use 8px radii. The retired `266:3212` is hidden and retains its IDs.
- Mobile calendar cards `270:3669` / `270:3701` open `149:9366`. Post detail highlights Calendar. Duplicate Review detail section headings are hidden, retaining their IDs and visible field labels.
- Hand-over uses the confirmation route: `149:16937` → `151:8468`. All four confirmation frames are retained, including `151:8132`, `151:8804`, `151:9037`.
- All Confirm · Lead frames begin First name, Last name, Email, Phone, Notes, then preserve Lead draft and Source conversation context.
- CRM input edge #848da3 has at least 3:1 contrast against both white and CRM canvas. Widget default line RGB .48/.48/.52 is above 3:1 against client paper. Field/menu padding follows 0/8/16/24. Widget actions and Close are at least 44px; Literata and Atkinson Hyperlegible are bound to client heading/body font variables.
- Source chips have a URL action opening the existing `[Source link]` slot in a new tab. This is an unresolved data placeholder, not a fabricated or verified external link. Real source destinations remain dependent on returned client data.
- Conversation → Answer after 0.8 seconds. Sending uses one 0.8-second conditional: `client/reply-has-source=true` → Answer; false → No source, on components and all six width/data specimens. The widget body intentionally scrolls above its separate composer.
- Native registers `151:3973` / `154:4349` and existing canvas mirrors are updated and read-back verified. No design is marked newly Approved. No production code, deployment, secrets or main-branch changes.

Full structural/contrast results: [checks.json](checks.json). Full successful mutation receipts: [changes.json](changes.json). The lists below contain every directly edited/created node returned by successful batches, including intermediate instance-child IDs changed by a variant swap. Inherited propagation is represented by its changed component and dependent instance roots, rather than claiming each inherited child was directly edited.
